title: CSR Verification Specialist (0326)
description:
Pay Rate: $15/hr
Location: Onsite – Must report daily to the assignment location.

Training Schedule:

  • Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

  • Attendance is mandatory for the entirety of the training period. CANNOT MISS ANY TIME DURING TRAINING

Post-Training Schedule:

  • Must be available to work Monday through Friday between the hours of 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver professional, knowledgeable, and enthusiastic customer service over the phone.

  • Accurately direct phone calls to the appropriate staff and escalate trends or issues to supervisors as needed.

  • Maintain compliance with onsite technical and operational requirements, ensuring seamless communication and task completion.

Qualifications:

  • Technical Proficiency: Must be technically savvy, with the ability to independently operate a computer and troubleshoot basic issues.

  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication abilities, with a minimum typing speed of 30 words per minute.

  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent.

Notes:

  • This is an onsite position; candidates must report to the designated location daily.

  • Candidates must demonstrate excellent adaptability and technical capability to meet the demands of the role.
